title: Amira frontend protocol v1
description: One JSON object per line on the control channel. Validate client frames with ClientFrame and server frames with ServerFrame. See docs/protocol.md.

AckFrame.title: AckFrame
AckFrame.description: Client confirmation of the last applied event seq; id is the daemon epoch.

CancelFrame.title: CancelFrame
CancelFrame.description: Cancels a pending request by id.

ChunkFrame.title: ChunkFrame
ChunkFrame.description: One part of a frame whose encoded line would exceed the line limit.

ClientFrame.title: ClientFrame
ClientFrame.description: Any frame a frontend client may send.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Failed operation. error.code is a stable machine-readable code.

EventFrame.title: EventFrame
EventFrame.description: Ordered workspace event. seq increases by one within a daemon epoch.

EventPayload.title: EventPayload
EventPayload.description: Event payload: a core event (has type) or a workspace notification (has kind).

HelloFrame.title: HelloFrame
HelloFrame.description: First client frame. Selects the workspace and advertises the client's capabilities.

PingFrame.title: PingFrame
PingFrame.description: Heartbeat; the peer must answer with a pong carrying the same id.

RejectFrame.title: RejectFrame
RejectFrame.description: Handshake refusal; the server closes the connection after sending it.

RequestFrame.title: RequestFrame
RequestFrame.description: Client operation request on the control channel, correlated by id.

ResetFrame.title: ResetFrame
ResetFrame.description: Authoritative workspace snapshot that replaces all client state at seq.

ResponseFrame.title: ResponseFrame
ResponseFrame.description: Exactly one response per request id, unless the client cancelled it first.

ServerFrame.title: ServerFrame
ServerFrame.description: Any frame the server may send to a frontend client.

contextWindowSource.description: "provider" is sent only to peers advertising "context-window-source.provider".

WelcomeFrame.title: WelcomeFrame
WelcomeFrame.description: Server handshake reply: daemon epoch, generations and server capabilities.

WorkspaceSnapshot.title: WorkspaceSnapshot
WorkspaceSnapshot.description: Complete workspace state captured at one event cursor.
